name: moderant
description: Embeddable moderated chat for games on Cloudflare

scripts.build: pnpm -C worker-chat build && pnpm -C worker-moderation build && pnpm -C worker-warm build && pnpm -C worker-admin build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C worker-chat exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C worker-moderation exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C worker-warm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C worker-admin exec tsc --noEmit
